source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As a [battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, while this model is **destroyed**, a triple 6 in your [Blessings of Khorne](vsdata:ability/world-eaters.blessings-of-khorne) roll can go to this ability, in place of activating Blessings of Khorne that round. Then it counts as no longer **destroyed**, and when Reinforcements arrive in [your next Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), you set it up via **[Deep Strike](vsdata:core-ability/deep-strike)**, anywhere on the battlefield, with 8 wounds left.

prerequisites: triple 6 on Blessings of Khorne roll

return.timing: Reinforcements step of next own Movement phase
